WITH station_values AS (
  SELECT timestamp AS time, SUM(value) AS value
  FROM process_metrics
  WHERE station_name = 'system'
  GROUP BY timestamp
)
SELECT sv.time, sv.value, b.mean
FROM station_values sv
JOIN station_baseline_view b
  ON b.station_name = 'system'
WHERE $__timeFilter(sv.time)
ORDER BY sv.time;

DROP VIEW IF EXISTS public.system_overall_view;

CREATE VIEW public.system_overall_view AS
WITH config AS (
    SELECT 'system' AS station_name, 'cycle_time' AS exclude_metric
),
station_baseline AS (
    SELECT SUM(bm.mean) AS station_mean, SQRT(SUM(bm.std_dev * bm.std_dev)) AS station_std
    FROM public.baseline_metrics bm, config
    WHERE bm.station_name = config.station_name AND bm.metric_name != config.exclude_metric
),
live_values AS (
    SELECT pm.timestamp AS time, SUM(pm.value) AS station_value
    FROM public.process_metrics pm, config
    WHERE pm.station_name = config.station_name AND pm.metric_name != config.exclude_metric
      AND $__timeFilter(pm.timestamp)
    GROUP BY pm.timestamp
),
ordered AS (
    SELECT lv.time, lv.station_value AS value, sb.station_mean AS mean, sb.station_std AS std,
           sb.station_mean + 2.5 * sb.station_std AS upper_2_5sigma,
           sb.station_mean - 2.5 * sb.station_std AS lower_2_5sigma,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY lv.time) AS rn
    FROM live_values lv CROSS JOIN station_baseline sb
),
rules AS (
    SELECT *,
        (ABS(value - mean) > 3 * std) AS rule1,
        CASE WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE value > mean) OVER (ORDER BY rn ROWS BETWEEN 8 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) = 9
          OR COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE value < mean) OVER (ORDER BY rn ROWS BETWEEN 8 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) = 9
        THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS rule2,
        CASE WHEN
            (value > LAG(value,1) OVER w AND LAG(value,1) OVER w > LAG(value,2) OVER w AND LAG(value,2) OVER w > LAG(value,3) OVER w AND LAG(value,3) OVER w > LAG(value,4) OVER w AND LAG(value,4) OVER w > LAG(value,5) OVER w)
          OR (value < LAG(value,1) OVER w AND LAG(value,1) OVER w < LAG(value,2) OVER w AND LAG(value,2) OVER w < LAG(value,3) OVER w AND LAG(value,3) OVER w < LAG(value,4) OVER w AND LAG(value,4) OVER w < LAG(value,5) OVER w)
        THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS rule3,
        CASE WHEN
            (SIGN(value - LAG(value,1) OVER w) != SIGN(LAG(value,1) OVER w - LAG(value,2) OVER w)) AND
            (SIGN(LAG(value,1) OVER w - LAG(value,2) OVER w) != SIGN(LAG(value,2) OVER w - LAG(value,3) OVER w)) AND
            (SIGN(LAG(value,2) OVER w - LAG(value,3) OVER w) != SIGN(LAG(value,3) OVER w - LAG(value,4) OVER w)) AND
            (SIGN(LAG(value,3) OVER w - LAG(value,4) OVER w) != SIGN(LAG(value,4) OVER w - LAG(value,5) OVER w)) AND
            (SIGN(LAG(value,4) OVER w - LAG(value,5) OVER w) != SIGN(LAG(value,5) OVER w - LAG(value,6) OVER w)) AND
            (SIGN(LAG(value,5) OVER w - LAG(value,6) OVER w) != SIGN(LAG(value,6) OVER w - LAG(value,7) OVER w)) AND
            (SIGN(LAG(value,6) OVER w - LAG(value,7) OVER w) != SIGN(LAG(value,7) OVER w - LAG(value,8) OVER w)) AND
            (SIGN(LAG(value,7) OVER w - LAG(value,8) OVER w) != SIGN(LAG(value,8) OVER w - LAG(value,9) OVER w)) AND
            (SIGN(LAG(value,8) OVER w - LAG(value,9) OVER w) != SIGN(LAG(value,9) OVER w - LAG(value,10) OVER w)) AND
            (SIGN(LAG(value,9) OVER w - LAG(value,10) OVER w) != SIGN(LAG(value,10) OVER w - LAG(value,11) OVER w)) AND
            (SIGN(LAG(value,10) OVER w - LAG(value,11) OVER w) != SIGN(LAG(value,11) OVER w - LAG(value,12) OVER w)) AND
            (SIGN(LAG(value,11) OVER w - LAG(value,12) OVER w) != SIGN(LAG(value,12) OVER w - LAG(value,13) OVER w))
        THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS rule4,
        CASE WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE value > mean + 2*std) OVER (ORDER BY rn ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) >= 2
          OR COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE value < mean - 2*std) OVER (ORDER BY rn ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) >= 2
        THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS rule5,
        CASE WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE value > mean + std) OVER (ORDER BY rn ROWS BETWEEN 4 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) >= 4
          OR COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE value < mean - std) OVER (ORDER BY rn ROWS BETWEEN 4 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) >= 4
        THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS rule6,
        CASE WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ABS(value - mean) < std) OVER (ORDER BY rn ROWS BETWEEN 14 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) = 15
        THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS rule7,
        CASE WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ABS(value - mean) > std) OVER (ORDER BY rn ROWS BETWEEN 7 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) = 8
        THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS rule8
    FROM ordered WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY rn)
),
final AS (SELECT *, (rule1 OR rule2 OR rule3 OR rule4 OR rule5 OR rule6 OR rule7 OR rule8) AS any_violation FROM rules)
SELECT time, value, mean, upper_2_5sigma, lower_2_5sigma,
    CASE WHEN any_violation THEN value ELSE NULL END AS anomaly_point,
    CASE WHEN any_violation THEN CONCAT_WS(' | ',
        CASE WHEN rule1 THEN 'Rule 1: Beyond 3σ (Extreme outlier)' END,
        CASE WHEN rule2 THEN 'Rule 2: 9 same side (Shift detected)' END,
        CASE WHEN rule3 THEN 'Rule 3: 6 trend (Drift detected)' END,
        CASE WHEN rule4 THEN 'Rule 4: 14 alternating (Oscillation)' END,
        CASE WHEN rule5 THEN 'Rule 5: 2 of 3 beyond 2σ (Early warning)' END,
        CASE WHEN rule6 THEN 'Rule 6: 4 of 5 beyond 1σ (Gradual shift)' END,
        CASE WHEN rule7 THEN 'Rule 7: 15 within 1σ (Stratification)' END,
        CASE WHEN rule8 THEN 'Rule 8: 8 beyond 1σ both sides (Mixture)' END
    ) ELSE '' END AS rule_description
FROM final ORDER BY time;

SELECT
  time AS "time",
  mean,
  upper_2_5sigma,
  lower_2_5sigma,
  anomaly_point
FROM system_overall_view
WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
ORDER BY time;

panels.description: Station breakdown at the clicked anomaly point. Red/orange = anomalous. Click station name to open its dashboard.

targets.rawSql:
WITH clicked_time AS (
  SELECT '${__value.time}'::timestamptz AS ts
),
station_values AS (
  SELECT pm.station_name, SUM(pm.value) AS station_value
  FROM public.process_metrics pm, clicked_time
  WHERE pm.timestamp = clicked_time.ts AND pm.station_name != 'system'
  GROUP BY pm.station_name
),
station_baselines AS (
  SELECT bm.station_name,
    SUM(bm.mean) AS station_mean,
    SQRT(SUM(bm.std_dev * bm.std_dev)) AS station_std
  FROM public.baseline_metrics bm
  WHERE bm.station_name != 'system'
  GROUP BY bm.station_name
),
station_violations AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT pm.station_name
  FROM public.process_metrics pm
  JOIN public.baseline_metrics bm ON bm.station_name = pm.station_name AND bm.metric_name = pm.metric_name,
  clicked_time
  WHERE pm.timestamp = clicked_time.ts
    AND pm.station_name != 'system'
    AND ABS(pm.value - bm.mean) > 2.5 * bm.std_dev
)
SELECT
  sv.station_name AS "Station",
  ROUND(sv.station_value::numeric, 3) AS "Cycle Value",
  ROUND(sb.station_mean::numeric, 3) AS "Baseline Mean",
  ROUND((sb.station_mean + 2.5 * sb.station_std)::numeric, 3) AS "Upper 2.5σ",
  ROUND((sb.station_mean - 2.5 * sb.station_std)::numeric, 3) AS "Lower 2.5σ",
  CASE
    WHEN sv.station_value > sb.station_mean + 2.5 * sb.station_std THEN '⚠ Above 2.5σ'
    WHEN sv.station_value < sb.station_mean - 2.5 * sb.station_std THEN '⚠ Below 2.5σ'
    WHEN viol.station_name IS NOT NULL THEN '⚠ Metric Violation'
    ELSE '✅ Normal'
  END AS "Status"
FROM station_values sv
JOIN station_baselines sb USING (station_name)
LEFT JOIN station_violations viol USING (station_name)
ORDER BY
  (sv.station_value > sb.station_mean + 2.5 * sb.station_std
   OR sv.station_value < sb.station_mean - 2.5 * sb.station_std
   OR viol.station_name IS NOT NULL) DESC,
  sv.station_name;

            (SIGN(LAG(value,10) OVER w - LAG(value,11) OVER w) != SIGN(LAG(value,11) OVER w - LAG(value,12) OVER w)) AND
            (SIGN(LAG(value,11) OVER w - LAG(value,12) OVER w) != SIGN(LAG(value,12) OVER w - LAG(value,13) OVER w))
        THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS rule4,
        CASE WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE value > mean + 2*std) OVER (ORDER BY rn ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) >= 2
          OR COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE value < mean - 2*std) OVER (ORDER BY rn ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) >= 2
        THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS rule5,
        CASE WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE value > mean + std) OVER (ORDER BY rn ROWS BETWEEN 4 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) >= 4
          OR COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE value < mean - std) OVER (ORDER BY rn ROWS BETWEEN 4 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) >= 4
        THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS rule6,
        CASE WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ABS(value - mean) < std) OVER (ORDER BY rn ROWS BETWEEN 14 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) = 15
        THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS rule7,
        CASE WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ABS(value - mean) > std) OVER (ORDER BY rn ROWS BETWEEN 7 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) = 8
        THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS rule8
    FROM ordered WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY rn)
),
final AS (SELECT *, (rule1 OR rule2 OR rule3 OR rule4 OR rule5 OR rule6 OR rule7 OR rule8) AS any_violation FROM rules)
SELECT time, value, mean, upper_2_5sigma, lower_2_5sigma,
    CASE WHEN any_violation THEN value ELSE NULL END AS anomaly_point,
    CASE WHEN any_violation THEN CONCAT_WS(' | ',
        CASE WHEN rule1 THEN 'Rule 1: Beyond 3σ (Extreme outlier)' END,
        CASE WHEN rule2 THEN 'Rule 2: 9 same side (Shift detected)' END,
        CASE WHEN rule3 THEN 'Rule 3: 6 trend (Drift detected)' END,
        CASE WHEN rule4 THEN 'Rule 4: 14 alternating (Oscillation)' END,
        CASE WHEN rule5 THEN 'Rule 5: 2 of 3 beyond 2σ (Early warning)' END,
        CASE WHEN rule6 THEN 'Rule 6: 4 of 5 beyond 1σ (Gradual shift)' END,
        CASE WHEN rule7 THEN 'Rule 7: 15 within 1σ (Stratification)' END,
        CASE WHEN rule8 THEN 'Rule 8: 8 beyond 1σ both sides (Mixture)' END
    ) ELSE '' END AS rule_description
FROM final ORDER BY time;

SELECT

DROP VIEW IF EXISTS public.system_total_time_view;

CREATE VIEW public.system_total_time_view AS
WITH ordered AS (
    SELECT pm.timestamp AS time, pm.value, bm.mean, bm.std_dev AS std,
        bm.mean + (2.5 * bm.std_dev) AS upper_2_5sigma,
        bm.mean - (2.5 * bm.std_dev) AS lower_2_5sigma,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY pm.timestamp) AS rn
    FROM public.process_metrics pm
    JOIN public.baseline_metrics bm ON bm.station_name = pm.station_name AND bm.metric_name = pm.metric_name
    WHERE pm.station_name = 'system' AND pm.metric_name = 'total_time'
),
rules AS (
    SELECT *,
        (ABS(value - mean) > 3 * std) AS rule1,
        CASE WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE value > mean) OVER (ORDER BY rn ROWS BETWEEN 8 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) = 9
          OR COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE value < mean) OVER (ORDER BY rn ROWS BETWEEN 8 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) = 9
        THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS rule2,
        CASE WHEN
            (value > LAG(value,1) OVER w AND LAG(value,1) OVER w > LAG(value,2) OVER w AND LAG(value,2) OVER w > LAG(value,3) OVER w AND LAG(value,3) OVER w > LAG(value,4) OVER w AND LAG(value,4) OVER w > LAG(value,5) OVER w)
          OR (value < LAG(value,1) OVER w AND LAG(value,1) OVER w < LAG(value,2) OVER w AND LAG(value,2) OVER w < LAG(value,3) OVER w AND LAG(value,3) OVER w < LAG(value,4) OVER w AND LAG(value,4) OVER w < LAG(value,5) OVER w)
        THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS rule3,
        CASE WHEN
            (SIGN(value - LAG(value,1) OVER w) != SIGN(LAG(value,1) OVER w - LAG(value,2) OVER w)) AND
            (SIGN(LAG(value,1) OVER w - LAG(value,2) OVER w) != SIGN(LAG(value,2) OVER w - LAG(value,3) OVER w)) AND
            (SIGN(LAG(value,2) OVER w - LAG(value,3) OVER w) != SIGN(LAG(value,3) OVER w - LAG(value,4) OVER w)) AND
            (SIGN(LAG(value,3) OVER w - LAG(value,4) OVER w) != SIGN(LAG(value,4) OVER w - LAG(value,5) OVER w)) AND
            (SIGN(LAG(value,4) OVER w - LAG(value,5) OVER w) != SIGN(LAG(value,5) OVER w - LAG(value,6) OVER w)) AND
            (SIGN(LAG(value,5) OVER w - LAG(value,6) OVER w) != SIGN(LAG(value,6) OVER w - LAG(value,7) OVER w)) AND
            (SIGN(LAG(value,6) OVER w - LAG(value,7) OVER w) != SIGN(LAG(value,7) OVER w - LAG(value,8) OVER w)) AND
            (SIGN(LAG(value,7) OVER w - LAG(value,8) OVER w) != SIGN(LAG(value,8) OVER w - LAG(value,9) OVER w)) AND
            (SIGN(LAG(value,8) OVER w - LAG(value,9) OVER w) != SIGN(LAG(value,9) OVER w - LAG(value,10) OVER w)) AND
            (SIGN(LAG(value,9) OVER w - LAG(value,10) OVER w) != SIGN(LAG(value,10) OVER w - LAG(value,11) OVER w)) AND
            (SIGN(LAG(value,10) OVER w - LAG(value,11) OVER w) != SIGN(LAG(value,11) OVER w - LAG(value,12) OVER w)) AND
            (SIGN(LAG(value,11) OVER w - LAG(value,12) OVER w) != SIGN(LAG(value,12) OVER w - LAG(value,13) OVER w))
        THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS rule4,
        CASE WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE value > mean + 2*std) OVER (ORDER BY rn ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) >= 2
          OR COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE value < mean - 2*std) OVER (ORDER BY rn ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) >= 2
        THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS rule5,
        CASE WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE value > mean + std) OVER (ORDER BY rn ROWS BETWEEN 4 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) >= 4
          OR COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE value < mean - std) OVER (ORDER BY rn ROWS BETWEEN 4 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) >= 4
        THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS rule6,
        CASE WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ABS(value - mean) < std) OVER (ORDER BY rn ROWS BETWEEN 14 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) = 15
        THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS rule7,
        CASE WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ABS(value - mean) > std) OVER (ORDER BY rn ROWS BETWEEN 7 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) = 8
        THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS rule8
    FROM ordered WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY rn)
),
final AS (SELECT *, (rule1 OR rule2 OR rule3 OR rule4 OR rule5 OR rule6 OR rule7 OR rule8) AS any_violation FROM rules)
SELECT time, value, mean, upper_2_5sigma, lower_2_5sigma,
    CASE WHEN any_violation THEN value ELSE NULL END AS anomaly_point,
    CASE WHEN any_violation THEN CONCAT_WS(' | ',
        CASE WHEN rule1 THEN 'Rule 1: Beyond 3σ (Extreme outlier)' END,
        CASE WHEN rule2 THEN 'Rule 2: 9 same side (Shift detected)' END,
        CASE WHEN rule3 THEN 'Rule 3: 6 trend (Drift detected)' END,
        CASE WHEN rule4 THEN 'Rule 4: 14 alternating (Oscillation)' END,
        CASE WHEN rule5 THEN 'Rule 5: 2 of 3 beyond 2σ (Early warning)' END,
        CASE WHEN rule6 THEN 'Rule 6: 4 of 5 beyond 1σ (Gradual shift)' END,
        CASE WHEN rule7 THEN 'Rule 7: 15 within 1σ (Stratification)' END,
        CASE WHEN rule8 THEN 'Rule 8: 8 beyond 1σ both sides (Mixture)' END
    ) ELSE '' END AS rule_description
FROM final ORDER BY time;
